Each file keeps one party's Table III.1 sheets from its BTR1 common tabular format workbook, as archived in the scoping repository's `data/raw/unfccc_btr1/`. The rows above and including the header block are copied verbatim; two to five data rows follow with their amounts replaced, their titles replaced by "Activity A", "Activity B" and so on, and their additional information cleared. Each sheet ends with the template's abbreviation and footnote rows.

- `USA-table-1.xlsx`: `United_States_of_America__USA_Support_CTF_Dec19.xlsx`, sheets `Table 1_2021` and `Table 1_2022` (USD million, currency labels in the header row and "Face value" under them, 2022 amounts in the domestic column only).
- `GBR-table-1.xlsx`: `United_Kingdom__GBR-CTF-FTC-2024-V0.1-20240819-163835_started_1_.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (GBP and USD million, rate "$1=0.727 GBP", programme number 201575 leading a title).
- `CAN-tables.zip`: `Canada__CAN-CTF-FTC-Tables.zip`, member `CAN-CTF-FTC-FTCIII.1.xlsm`, sheet `Table III.1` (labels repeated in a lower header row, a year column), zipped with a text file that is not a workbook.
- `BEL-table-1.xlsx`: `Belgium__BTR1_support_20212022.xlsx`, sheet `Table1-2021` (rate inside the label cell, "Exchange rate used:0.881", status "provided", one USD amount cleared).
- `DEU-table-1.xlsx`: `Germany__DEU-CTF-FTC-2024.xlsx`, sheets `Table1_2021` and `Table1_2022` (the same activities on both sheets, amounts on 2021 only, "NA" on 2022), with an added row labelled "Total".
- `DNK-table-1.xlsx`: `Denmark__DNK_CTF_FTC_2024_V0.11_Dec_20_Table_III.1_2021_and_Table_III.4-5_2021_.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (one activity reported committed and disbursed).
- `FRA-table-1.xlsx`: `France__FRA-CTF-FTC-2024-V0.2-20241112-142707_vf.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (USD left empty, rate 0.8455).
- `AUS-table-1.xlsx`: `Australia__05._Annex_III_-_Support_CTFs.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (grant equivalent only).
- `FIN-table-1.xlsx`: `Finland__FIN-CTF-FTC-2024-V0.1-20241218-150513_approved.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` ("NA" lines around the recipient, the aggregate rows "Other bilateral projects" and "Finnfund climate-related investments", a title-only row, a row of "UA").
- `MCO-table-1.xlsx`: `Monaco__MCO-CTF-FTC-2024-V1.0-20260226-165918_awaiting_submission.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (footnote number glued to an amount, "100000(2)").
- `CHL-table-1.xlsx`: `Chile__CHL-CTF-FTC-2024.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2023` (decimal commas, status "Terminado").
- `IDN-table-1.xlsx`: `Indonesia__3._CTF_Tables_FTC_Support_Needed_and_Received_11_Dec_2024_Final.xlsx`, sheet `Table 1` (no year in the sheet, each row's year in its additional information cell, grant equivalent only).
- `HUN-table-1.xlsx`: `Hungary__Annex_III_BTR-1_Hungary_Support.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (rate "1 USD=303,29 HUF", grant-equivalent USD cleared).
- `NLD-table-1.xlsx`: `Netherlands__NLD-CTF-FTC-2024-V1.0-20241216-102903_final-checked.xlsx`, sheet `Table1_2021` (rate "1 EUR = 1.183 USD (=1/0.845)", USD cleared).
